title: Kissed Creamy Filipino Pork Skillet
description: A funky and creamy Filipino dish featuring pork shoulder steaks, this recipe is kid-friendly and Whole30-friendly. It is cooked in a tava-griddle vessel.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large tava-griddle vessel over medium-high heat.
Add the pork pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the vessel and set aside.
In the same vessel, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Pour in the coconut milk, fish sauce, and lime juice, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
Return the pork to the vessel and stir to coat with the creamy sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until the pork is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
